title: Start here — accepted baseline plus recovery line
summary: Wire UI Builder v0.11 remains the executable anchor. The ergonomics8/9 line is documented development/recovery work that adds resource-object import, notNotes Web reference integration, HTTP-front qualification and truthful browser readiness without silently promoting itself over v0.11.
invariants: Do not pull consumer business logic into Builder Studio.
Do not treat development/recovery artifacts as accepted executable heads unless separately qualified and promoted.
The compiled runtime contract remains renderer-neutral; browser markup, Win32 resources and native handles are projections/provenance rather than application truth.
Use the real Builder/Server/gateway path for acceptance; a static page or bare WebSocket connection is not a synchronized Builder view.
